title: THE GOLD TRACKER
lesson: Looking rich costs more than money
caption: Spending just to look rich? THE RULE BOOK Ep 24 (Day 4/80): They ran from the Collector all night on the train to Bulawayo, and Clyde STILL won't take off the free gold watch (it's a tracker) because it makes him look rich. Solo: you look rich AND easy to find. Score: SOLO 2, US 3. Clyde finally threw it out the window... then confessed where he hid the pages. A) Jump off B) Pull the brake. A or B? Send this to your Clyde. #liferules #lifestylecreep #stickman

lines: I'M NEVER TAKING OFF THIS WATCH.
IT'S A TRACKER. WE RAN ALL NIGHT!
BUT IT MAKES ME LOOK RICH, NO CAP.
YOU LOOK RICH. AND EASY TO FIND.
IT COSTS CASH, SLEEP... AND YOUR GPS.
